Back detail shows the two revised C48 supply-via approaches without adding a via or moving the capacitor.

Surface overviews and the six-inner-layer contact sheet show the retained C-shaped board with extensive incomplete routing.
scope: Five detailed copper views cover all replaced segments, plus three overview images. Does not establish installed fit, complete routing, electrical/thermal qualification or fabrication acceptance.
